entry.name: mc.targetlist
entry.digest: Format messages based on inlet number for controlling MC objects
entry.description: The mc.targetlist object simplifies creating the setvalue messages used to target specific instances within MC wrapper objects. The object maps the index of an inlet where a message was received to a voice index used in the resulting setvalue message.

arguments.name: prepend
arguments.description: A symbol argument, if present, sets a message to use inmessage output. For example, if the argument is, the resulting message output for voice index 1 and an int with a value of 10 would be.

arguments.name: voice index
arguments.description: You can specify one or more voice index values to be associated with each inlet. For example, if the arguments are 5 6 7 8, four inlets are created and the left inlet is associated with voice index 5, the next inlet with 6, and so on. If no numbers are supplied as arguments, two inlets are created. The left inlet is associated with voice index 1 and the right inlet with voice index 2.

arguments.name: inlet count
arguments.description: To specify a number of inlets without having to type in a voice index for each one, precede an inlet count value with.and the inlet count must be the last typed-in arguments.
